item.title: Rotary learns about Natchitoches economic development
item.description: Mike Newton welcomed and introduced the Executive Director of the Natchitoches Area Chamber of Commerce Laura Lyles at the Dec. 16 Rotary meeting. Lyles presented an overview of the business, retention, expansion, marketing, communications, support, and the workforce development of the Natchitoches Economic Development Alliance (NEDA). Pictured from left are Newton, Lyles, and Kirk Soileaux.

item.title: Trust-based relational intervention with LA Supreme Court FINS Assistance Program
item.description: From Dec. 10–12, the Natchitoches Parish School Board (NPSB), in partnership with the Louisiana Supreme Court Families in Need of Services (FINS) Assistance Program, hosted a three-day Trust-Based Relational Intervention (TBRI) training aimed at strengthening support systems for children who have experienced trauma.
